source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.
source.campaign_title_visible: Pine Haven Estate Sale — Houston, Texas
source.event_date_visible: Saturday June 13 9AM–2PM · Sunday June 14 10AM–2PM · Pine Haven neighborhood, Houston, Texas

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Left ~40% cream panel: crest → seller name → PINE HAVEN (navy serif caps) → 'Estate Sale' (gold calligraphic script with brush underline) → HOUSTON, TEXAS → two calendar-icon rows (day, date large, hours) → pin icon with neighbourhood. Right ~60%: photograph of a room vignette. Bottom: navy band + gold band with URL and social icons.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Photograph of the actual vignette: Empire chest with marble top, tripod table, urn-form lamp base, large blue/green/yellow abstract painting, porcelain, brass scales, corner of a striped chair. In situ; no extraction.
visual_read.composition_style: Left panel + right environmental photograph; the photo bleeds to the right and bottom edges above the bands.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Formal navy serif caps for the place name paired with a gold script for 'Estate Sale' — a deliberate formal/soft contrast; icon-led date rows.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller crest and name lead the panel; URL and social icons in the gold band.
visual_read.footer_treatment: Two stacked bands (navy, gold) spanning full width with globe icon + URL + Facebook/Instagram icons.
visual_read.photographic_style: Interior photograph, natural light on wood floors; the abstract painting supplies the colour.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Fully environmental — the actual vignette in the house.

strongest_attributes: Formal caps + script contrast in the title — the same instinct as the Owner's 'Heritage / italic Home' preference
Icon-led date rows for a two-day sale
The photograph's painting provides the colour; the panel stays quiet
Neighbourhood named as the location — geographic promotion inside an estate-sale ad
transferable_lessons: When an event title contains contrasting ideas (place + 'Estate Sale'), typography may express the contrast (validates the 3M.3 italic-Home principle; script is one acceptable expression, not a default)
Left panel + environmental photograph is the second estate-sale layout the Owner accepts
Icon-led date rows are an accepted device for multi-day on-site events
do_not_generalize: Crest, gold script face, brush-stroke underline, navy/gold bands — seller identity
Social icons in the band — Advantage.Bid's band carries the wordmark only

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Five blocks in one column, two of them icon-led date rows; the photograph is untouched by text.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: At budget when the date rows count as one 'essential event info' block.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Real room vignette; composition is the photographer's.
composition_assessment.depth: Photographic; chest and painting mid, chair corner foreground.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Photo bleeds right and bottom; panel contained.

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
